scope: Original hand-authored engineering demonstration and public regression requirements. This is not an agent comparison or a superiority result.

campaign.reason: Host trials, independent repetitions, hidden schedules, blind judgments and frozen study inputs remain pending.

inputPolicy.retarget: Preserve current visible position and velocity; do not reset to an endpoint or disable controls.
inputPolicy.scrub: Held direct seek follows pointer in both directions. Release and cancellation keep the held pose paused. Resume moves toward the current desired endpoint.
inputPolicy.replay: An explicit replay may reset to the assembled pose and then open. Its authorized reset is excluded from retarget continuity.

calibration.thresholdPolicy: Calibrate the development fixture before freezing agent study inputs. Do not loosen thresholds to make a failed run pass.
calibration.sceneObservation: App-reported post-render projected geometry. It cannot independently certify painted pixels.
calibration.responseObservation: Browser-observed trusted input to first changed post-render scene annotation; independently rendered response is unverified without aligned native pixels.

requirements: All controls remain enabled and keyboard reachable while moving.
Opening, rapid wide-to-standard-to-tele selection, reversal and inspector finish in the latest requested useful state.
Held scrub reversals and pointer cancellation preserve the held pose and paused playback state.
Pause stops motion and resume preserves state; replay completes from its explicit reset.
Export downloads real selected configuration JSON with the selected lens and requested final view.
Reduced motion works from load and when the media preference changes during motion.
No WebGL, including forced context failure, renders a useful SVG fallback with the same controls and export.
Desktop and narrow viewports do not overflow horizontally; resize during motion preserves latest state.
Actual native recordings, endpoint screenshots, source provenance and failed-run artifacts are retained.
Encoded video cadence and callback state cannot certify display FPS, pixel presentation latency, aesthetic quality or human trackability.
selectedLensIdentity: The selected physical scene actor is lens-${selected}. Track its stable object identity; do not treat the convenience debug lens alias as physical-node continuity.
